children.name: Body
children.value: 4210 bytes, dropped by libogg and so by decoders, but handed to the codec parser as packets: the page is cut short

findings.message: The page at 0x81 is cut short after 4267 bytes of 4287 bytes; decoders drop it with its packets.

The logical stream 0x0F0F0030 has no end-of-stream page: its last page at 0x81 sets the flag but is damaged, so decoders drop it, and it ends before the end of the data, so the file was probably cut short or not finished.
